Title: LATAM FF Impact Analyst
Description: Viatris Healthcare México S. de R.L. de C.V Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here is how the LATAM FF Impact Analyst role will make an impact: The LATAM FF Impact Analyst is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing the return on investment (ROI) of medical visits and all promotional support provided to healthcare professionals (HCPs) across LATAM. This role ensures that field force activities, sampling strategies, medical support initiatives, and other promotional investments generate measurable business impact while strictly adhering to compliance standards and corporate governance policies. The position plays a critical role in elevating LATAM’s analytical maturity by linking activity, investment, and outcomes, enabling data-driven decision-making and reinforcing ethical and compliant promotional practices across the region. Key responsibilities for this role include: Field Force Impact & ROI Monitoring Design and implement frameworks to measure ROI of medical visits, sampling, and promotional investments across markets. Develop activity-to-impact models linking call frequency, segmentation, sampling, and commercial outcomes (Rx, sales, DDD). Monitor field force productivity and effectiveness indicators across clusters Identify performance gaps, threats, and growth opportunities through advanced analytics. Provide regular impact assessments to regional and country leadership teams. Standardize impact measurement methodologies across markets. Embed ROI and impact insights into governance routines and business reviews. Evaluate the effectiveness of medical samples, promotional materials, events, and other HCP support initiatives. Develop standardized metrics and dashboards to monitor promotional investment performance. Support resource reallocation decisions based on ROI and impact analysis. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Country Leadership teams. Support incentive design by ensuring alignment between investment, activity, and measurable outcomes. Coordinate with Global teams to align methodologies and best practices. Success Indicators Clear and measurable linkage between field force activity and business outcomes. Improved ROI of medical visits and promotional investments across LATAM. Standardized regional impact measurement framework. Increased analytical maturity and data-driven decision-making within the organization. Qualifications for this role are: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Life Sciences, or related field. 2-3 years of experience in Business Analytics, Sales Force Effectiveness, Commercial Excellence, or similar roles within pharmaceuticals or healthcare. Strong experience in ROI analysis, performance analytics, and CRM data interpretation. Experience working in multi-country or regional environments preferred. Professional proficiency in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a strong plus. Skills/Requirements Strong analytical and quantitative skills. Ability to translate data into actionable business insights. High integrity and strong compliance mindset. Structured, detail-oriented, and results-driven. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to operate in a cross-functional environment. At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Description: Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com Job Description Please submit your application in English. We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Data Analyst with a strong focus on project systems, analytics, and information management to support major capital programs and portfolios across the construction sector. This role bridges project controls systems, information management, and data analytics. You will help clients unlock value from their data, improve delivery performance, and align their ways of working with modern digital tools. The right candidate will demonstrate hands-on experience in reviewing, compiling, and visualizing complex data sets while actively supporting PMIS implementations and continuous improvement efforts. You will be a curious problem-solver who brings ideas on how to further develop our analysis capabilities and works collaboratively to deliver impactful results. Key Responsibilities System Implementation: Support the configuration, implementation, and optimization of PMIS systems for large PMOs, focusing on cost, risk, schedule, and portfolio tools. Requirements & Strategy: Assist in the development, validation, and translation of business and system requirements into practical digital solutions and technical documentation. Data Analysis & Visualization: Review, compile, interpret, and visualize complex data sets. Design and implement impactful dashboarding and reporting solutions to enable insight-led decision-making. Data Integration: Support the integration of project, cost, schedule, and asset data across the PMO into a centralized reporting framework. Continuous Improvement: Give ideas and input on how to further develop internal analysis and modeling capabilities. Actively engage with emerging industry trends to embed learning into delivery. Communication: Contribute to high-quality documentation, presentations, and stakeholder communications, clearly translating technical data insights to non-technical audiences. Technical Knowledge Data Analysis & Databases: Experience writing SQL scripts and querying relational databases to extract and manage datasets. Dashboarding, Automation & Workspace Ecosystems: Practical experience building and maintaining visualizations using enterprise tools like Looker Studio (Data Studio) and internal platforms (e.g., Plx Dashboards), combined with experience driving reporting automation, data integration, and collaborative workflows within cloud-based productivity suites (e.g., connected spreadsheets, Apps Script). Data Modeling Foundations: Solid foundation in Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups) with an understanding of VBA for data manipulation and modeling. Data Standards: Solid understanding of Data and Information Management standards within a capital project or PMO environment. Qualifications 5–8 years of professional experience in data analysis, systems implementation, or project analytics, preferred within the real estate or construction sectors. Degree in a STEM discipline, Data Science, IT, or equivalent. Experience supporting client-facing data-enabled change, from engagement start-up through to implementation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to confidently present data insights and technical concepts to both internal teams and clients. A self-starter attitude with a focus on delivering results and adaptability to challenges within a collaborative team. Fluent English is required.
